correctness.rationale: Let M be point-block incidence for any existing AD(n,mu). The design identities MM^T=kI+lambda J and M^T M=kI+mu(J_r-I_r) tensor J_n split real point and block spaces into v-1 corresponding singular directions with 2x2 B1, r-1 uncoupled parallel-class contrasts with scalar L=f0-n f2+(n-1)f4, and two constant directions with 2x2 B0. Total 2(v-1)+(r-1)+2=v+b dimensions, so PSD iff L>=0, B1>=0, B0>=0, including singular cases and arbitrary automorphism groups. For exponential f_j=z^j with w=z² and 0<w<1, direct determinant identities give L=(1-w)(1-(n-1)w), det B1=(1-w)^2(1-(k-1)w), and det B0=(1-w)/(n-1)*[(n-1)+beta w+gamma w²]. Positive diagonal pivots reduce PSD to w<=1/(k-1) and the quadratic inequality; a=0 separately yields the all-ones rank-one kernel. In AG(3,3), n=3,k=9,r=13, determinant factor 1-54w+416w² has roots (27±sqrt313)/416 both below 1/8, yielding exactly two positive-a disconnected PSD bands, with rank 40 at w=1/8 and 65 at the two quadratic boundaries. Independent symbolic algebra checked all determinant factors, inequalities, and root ordering; the singular-value proof handles all actual designs. The design's existence assumption is explicit, no universal (n,mu) existence assertion.

originality.rationale: Ma 2016 explicitly derives spectral factorization and distance signature for affine-resolvable incidence graphs at the one specific radial weight f_d=d, supplying the essential design identities and singular-space structure. DeVille 2017/2020 treats arbitrary radial weights on distance-regular graphs and Cartesian products, where distance-class matrices commute, whereas these incidence graphs are biregular for r != k and their B1 distance-one and distance-two restrictions do not commute. This structural nonapplicability prevents a direct theorem specialization. The present exact all-parameter 5-weight PSD cone plus disconnected AG(3,3) exponential kernel interval is a motivated extension; the possibility of equivalent older coherent-config/block-matrix spectral computations remains explicit.
residual_risks: An older treatment via coherent configurations, incidence singular values or association schemes could imply the same 2x2 PSD test implicitly.
The cone is for distance-radial real symmetric kernels on existing affine designs, not all weighted kernels and not all hypothetical pairs (n,mu).
